videos.title: Who Really Makes Money From AI? | Kush Bavaria
Why Neo-Clouds are Great Businesses & The State of Compute with Kush Bavaria, Co-Founder @ Ornn
videos.description:
Kush Bavaria is the Co-founder and CEO of Ornn, building the financial market for AI compute. Ornn helps companies price, finance and hedge GPU capacity—bringing the tools of commodity markets to AI infrastructure. Kush is just 23 years old and has raised funding from some of the best in the world including Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital and BoxGroup.
